BotTracking.AIAssistantsReportDocumentation: Discover which AI assistants are crawling your site and how many hits each one generates. Expand a bot to review the most frequently requested pages or documents.
BotTracking.ColumnAcquiredVisitsDocumentation: Visits that started after someone clicked from an AI assistant (Referrers → AI Assistants).
BotTracking.ColumnDocumentRequestsDocumentation: Total number of bot requests to document URLs recorded during the selected period.
BotTracking.ColumnPageRequestsDocumentation: Total number of bot requests to page URLs recorded during the selected period.
BotTracking.ColumnRequestsDocumentation: Total number of bot requests recorded during the selected period. Includes both page and document URLs.
BotTracking.ColumnUniquePageUrlsDocumentation: Distinct page URLs requested by AI assistants.
BotTracking.ColumnUniqueDocumentUrlsDocumentation: Distinct download or document URLs requested by AI assistants.
BotTracking.ColumnUniqueAiChatbotsDocumentation: AI assistant user agents detected during the selected period.
BotTracking.ColumnNotFoundRequestsDocumentation: Number of bot requests that returned an HTTP 404 response, including document URLs.
BotTracking.ColumnServerErrorRequestsDocumentation: Number of bot requests that returned an HTTP 5xx response, including document URLs.
BotTracking.ColumnClickThroughRateDocumentation: Share of AI assistant requests that resulted in acquired visits (acquired visits ÷ requests).
BotTracking.BotsOverTimeReportDocumentation: This report charts the evolution of AI assistant activity. Click any metric to enlarge its graph and review the underlying trend.
BotTracking.PluginDescription: Track and analyze visits from AI bots such as ChatGPT-User and similar. This plugin helps you understand how AI-driven tools interact with your website by logging and reporting bot-triggered requests.
BotTracking.SegmentNotSupported: Report does not support segmentation. The data displayed is your standard, unsegmented report data.
